tutorial_world_cup_mode.description: Coach selection for career mode. Player picks a national team to manage through the World Cup.
selection_factors: squad star_power (marquee names for narrative interest)

international_break_engine.description: Club vs country tension system. During international breaks, club players get called up to national teams, creating rift/morale events.
mechanics: Players with high-profile clubs (top 5 leagues) generate bigger rift events
Players in same league as manager's club create direct scheduling conflicts
Injury during international duty triggers club morale penalty
Player refusing callup triggers national team morale penalty
Multiple players from same club called to different nations = squad depth stress

ranking_tiers.1: Elite favorites (Argentina, France, Brazil, England, Belgium, Spain, Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, Croatia)
ranking_tiers.2: Strong contenders (Uruguay, Colombia, Morocco, Japan, USA, Senegal, Iran, South Korea, Mexico, Switzerland)
ranking_tiers.3: Competitive squads (Turkey, Ecuador, Austria, Scotland, Norway, Sweden, Algeria, Tunisia, Australia, Canada, Egypt, Czechia, Paraguay, Ivory Coast)
ranking_tiers.4: Rising/Regional powers (Ghana, DR Congo, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Uzbekistan, Bosnia, Jordan, Panama, Cape Verde, South Africa)
